tools.name: render_html_to_pdf
tools.description:
Render an HTML document to a PDF, returned base64-encoded.

`html` is a complete HTML string. Inline any images, fonts and CSS as
`data:` URIs — external http(s) resources are not fetched, and no
JavaScript is executed (HTML + CSS only). Returns
`{"pdf_base64": "<base64-encoded PDF>", "pages": <page

title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: render_html_to_pdf · Private data: render_html_to_pdf · Public sink: render_html_to_pdf · Destructive: render_html_to_pdf.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: render_html_to_pdf · Private data: render_html_to_pdf · Public sink: render_html_to_pdf · Destructive: render_html_to_pdf

remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "render_html_to_pdf" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
